description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tri-Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Holy)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Firion], [Blood Weapon (II) Damage Tracker] and [Blood Weapon (II) Level]

description.name: Tri-Element Mode (Fire, Ice, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Holy] after using a Fire/Ice/Holy ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Firion
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Blood Weapon (II) (0~2), removed after using Blood Weapon (II) two times

description.name: Blood Weapon (II) Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Blood Weapon (II) level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Firion]

description.name: Blood Weapon (II) Level
description.text: Keeps track of Blood Weapon (II) level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Firion]

description.name: II
description.text: Twenty single attacks (1.00/1.10 each) capped at 9999/19999, followed by one single attack (10.00/11.00) capped at 99999 at Blood Weapon (II) level 0/1, removes Arcane Dyad Empowered: Firion from the user
